radial_shapes.definition: Fixed-centre radial type-1 DM density moments in spherical or iterated volume-equivalent ellipsoidal shells; b/a, c/a, triaxiality and sampling-resolved axes; potential shape requires a separate calculation
radial_shapes.selection: Explicit selected native FOF rows and saved epochs. Parent is either all type-1 DM in a complete proper support sphere or exact FOF type-1 membership in that proper support sphere; substructure remains included. Batch identities are epoch-local.
required_data: Complete native snapshot/catalogue, exact uint64 IDs, scale factor and h
Explicit radial-shapes request: proper radial edges, support, window, tensor estimator, iteration and bootstrap controls
Batch request schema radial-shape-batch-v1: selections with snapshot, host_row, exact scale_factor; explicit maximum_targets and memory_gib; figure/inspector registries
radial_shapes.domain: Measured shells only; failed bins stay incomplete. Sampling intervals exclude resolution, centering and contamination errors; convergence and coverage remain required.
